This code produces memory leak warning:
```js
import fetch from "node-fetch";
import { Agent } from "http";

const agent = new Agent( {
    "maxSockets": 1,
} );

for ( let n = 0; n < 30; n++ ) {
    fetch( "http://example.com/", { agent } ).then( res => console.log( res.status ) );
}
```
